step.break.title: break step config
step.break.description: Halts the pipeline when a condition on a context field holds; otherwise the step continues to next_step.

output_field.description: Context key whose value is reported as the pipeline's final output when the step halts.

condition.description: Halt condition evaluated over a context field; without it the step never halts.

input_field.description: Flat context key to evaluate; score conditions also read <input_field>.score.

match_value.description: Reference for equals, contains and label_equals; bare YAML booleans are normalised to YES or NO.

step.classify.title: classify step config
step.classify.description: Runs a classifier on a context field and writes the top label and its score.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published classifier model.

input_field.description: Context key holding the text to classify; an empty value skips the step with a warning.

output_field.description: Context key receiving the top label; the score lands in <output_field>.score.

threshold.description: Minimum score carried to downstream readers; the executor itself does not filter on it, and 0 is not sent.

step.decide.title: decide step config
step.decide.description: Asks a decision model typed questions (choice, score, noul) about a context field and writes the answers to the context.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published decision model.

input_field.description: Context key holding the state; messages passes the chat messages as a list of role and content, and an empty value skips the step with a warning.

output_field.description: Prefix of the context keys written: <prefix>.<question id> holds the answer and, for choice and score, .confidence, .mode and .probabilities follow.

questions.description: Id to question map in declaration order, or the string request to take the caller's questions; set exactly one of questions and prompts.

oneOf.description: Take the questions from the decision call that targets the pipeline.

prompts.description: Id to prompt the step renders itself with the pipeline's Jinja context, for a model without a template; set exactly one of questions and prompts.

question.description: A typed question: instructions plus exactly one of choice, score or noul.

instructions.description: The question; a string, map or list reaches the template as is.

choice.description: Pick one option: option key to description (null allowed), or a list of bare keys; at least one option.

noul.description: Yes or no question; an optional true and false description may be given.

prompt.description: A prompt the step renders itself: a template plus exactly one of choice, score or noul describing the answer shape.

template.description: A workspace templates id, or inline Jinja rendered against the pipeline context; a bare name that is no templates id fails the load.

choice.description: Distinct, non-empty option keys in the order the prompt lists them.

noul.description: Yes or no answer; use an empty map.

step.embed.title: embed step config
step.embed.description: Embeds a context field with an embedding model and writes the vector as a float array string.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published embedding model.

input_field.description: Context key holding the text to embed; an empty value skips the step with a warning.

output_field.description: Context key receiving the serialised vector.

step.guard.title: guard step config
step.guard.description: Classifier-backed input check that rejects the request, warns, or redacts the matched spans before generation.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published classifier model.

input_field.description: Context key to classify; prompt (or unset) means the request itself, inspected per scope, and any other key is classified alone.

scope.description: Turns inspected when the guard reads the request: last_user, user_turns, or conversation (every user, assistant and tool turn, system turns excluded); refused alongside any input_field other than prompt.

on_empty.description: What to do when there is no text to inspect: reject halts with the rendered message and skip passes to the next step; defaults to reject for the reject action and skip for warn and redact.

output_field.description: Redact only: context key receiving the redacted text (the original text when nothing matched); defaults to <step id>.redacted.

action.description: What happens when a trigger matches: reject halts the pipeline, warn flags and continues, redact masks the matched spans; the codec falls back to reject for unknown values.

trigger.description: Single trigger; ignored when triggers is non-empty.

triggers.description: Several triggers, any one of which fires the guard; wins over trigger.

message.description: Jinja template rendered on reject and returned as the failure message, with <step id>.label and <step id>.score available.

redact_with_entity_type.description: Redact only: replace each span with [LABEL] (upper-cased) instead of asterisks.

trigger.description: A classifier label and the minimum score that fires it.

score.description: Minimum score that fires the trigger; 0 means any score.

step.infer.title: infer step config
step.infer.description: Streams a generation from a text-generation model, writes the text to the context and records tool-call and reasoning diagnostics.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published text-generation model.

output_field.description: Context key receiving the full generated text (reasoning included unless strip_thinking is true).

tags.description: Reasoning and tool-call markers, inline or a bare string naming a workspace tags entry by id.

oneOf.description: Id of a workspace tags entry; an unknown id fails the load.

context.description: Typed Jinja variables (for example enable_thinking: false or reasoning_effort: medium) merged into the rendering context and forwarded as template_context when the engine renders the messages itself.

system.description: Jinja template prepended as a system turn, merged into the caller's system message when there is one.

inject_tools.description: When false, the caller's tools are hidden from the prompt.

server_tools.description: When false, the server-owned todo tools (set_todos, complete_todo, ask_user) are hidden from this step.

strip_thinking.description: When true, the span between the reasoning tags is removed from the stream, the step output and the conversation.

stream_thinking.description: For role internal steps only: forward reasoning deltas to the client while content and tool deltas stay suppressed.

trim_history.description: Drop older turns so the prompt plus max_tokens fits the engine's context window.

tool_extraction_template.description: A built-in dialect name (chatml-json, xml-function, gemma-call, glm-name-json, harmony) or inline Jinja rendering a JSON array of name and arguments from output and tools; unset tries chatml-json, xml-function and gemma-call in that order.

chat_template.description: A workspace templates id or inline Jinja replacing the model's own chat template for this step.

prompt.description: Prompt source: structured messages replacing the conversation, or one raw template (inline, file or workspace id) bypassing the chat template; a template takes precedence over messages and at most one template key may be set.

messages.description: Templated messages replacing the conversation; the result still goes through the chat template.

template.description: Inline raw Jinja template sent as a bare prompt, bypassing the chat template.

template_file.description: Path to a raw template file, resolved under the templates base directory unless absolute.

template_id.description: Id of a workspace templates entry, resolved to its content at load time.

role.description: Role of the turn; a blank role means user and an unknown one is treated as user.

content.description: Jinja template rendered against the pipeline context.

sampling.description: Step-level sampling; values apply only when non-zero, except temperature where 0 is greedy, and a request or loop retry override wins.

max_tokens.description: Completion cap, also the reservation trim_history keeps free; 0 keeps the engine default.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; 0 is greedy and a negative value keeps the engine default.

top_p.description: Nucleus threshold; 0 keeps the engine default.

tagMarker.description: A marker string, or a list whose first entry is the primary marker and the rest are alternatives (longest match wins).

tags.description: Inline reasoning and tool-call channel markers.

reasoning_open.description: Marker or markers opening the reasoning channel.

reasoning_close.description: Marker or markers closing the reasoning channel.

reasoning_repeatable.description: Whether the reasoning channel may reopen within one generation, as chained-channel dialects such as Harmony need; unset keeps the engine rule.

tool_open.description: Marker or markers opening the tool-call channel; a generation ending inside it finishes with tool_calls.

tool_close.description: Marker or markers closing the tool-call channel.

step.llm_guard.title: llm_guard step config
step.llm_guard.description: LLM-as-judge check where a text-generation model answers a screening prompt and the first token of its answer decides whether the request continues.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published text-generation model.

action.description: What happens on an unsafe verdict: reject halts the pipeline, warn flags and continues, and redact is unsupported and behaves as warn.

safe_token.description: Prefix the verdict must start with (case-insensitive, leading whitespace stripped) for the request to pass.

prompt.description: The screening prompt: chat messages or one raw template; template, template_file and template_id are mutually exclusive and take precedence over messages.

messages.description: Screening conversation sent through the chat template.

role.description: Message role; unknown values are treated as user.

content.description: Jinja template rendered into the message text.

template.description: Inline raw Jinja prompt sent as a bare string, bypassing the chat template.

template_file.description: Path to a raw template file, resolved under the templates directory unless absolute.

template_id.description: Id of a workspace templates entry, resolved to its content at load time.

sampling.description: Sampling override for the judge call; only max_tokens, temperature and top_p are forwarded.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; 0 is greedy and a negative value keeps the engine default.

presence_penalty.description: Accepted but not forwarded by this step.

frequency_penalty.description: Accepted but not forwarded by this step.

stop.description: Accepted but not forwarded by this step.

message.description: Jinja template rendered on reject and returned as the failure message.

context.description: Typed Jinja variables merged into the prompt and message rendering context and forwarded to the engine's chat template (for example reasoning_effort, enable_thinking); keys are free-form.

tags.description: The judge model's reasoning and tool-call markers, inline or as a bare string referencing a workspace tags entry by id.

oneOf.description: Id of a workspace tags entry.

input_field.description: Accepted but ignored; the prompt decides what is screened.

marker.description: One marker string or a list; the first entry is the primary marker and the rest are alternatives.

tags.description: Reasoning and tool-call channel markers of the model.

reasoning_repeatable.description: Whether the reasoning channel may reopen within one generation.

step.loop.title: loop step config
step.loop.description: Bounded back-edge that re-runs an earlier step until a condition holds, optionally injecting a corrective turn and tighter sampling on every retry; the exit edge is the envelope next_step.

loopback_step.description: Step to jump back to while the condition does not hold.

fallback_step.description: Step taken when max_iterations is reached; the envelope next_step when unset.

max_iterations.description: Hard ceiling on retries; must be positive.

loopback_message.description: Message appended to the conversation on every loop-back, never on exit or fallback.

role.description: Chat role of the injected message; unknown values fall back to user.

content.description: Jinja template rendered against the pipeline context at loop-back time; a render failure or empty result skips the injection.

retry_sampling_params.description: Sampling override applied to infer steps on the retry edge only and cleared on exit and on fallback.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate; only positive values are applied.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; 0 is greedy and a negative value is ignored.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability; only positive values are applied.

stop.description: Accepted by the codec but not applied on the retry edge.

condition.description: Exit condition evaluated over a context field; the loop exits through next_step when it holds.

input_field.description: Flat context key to evaluate; score conditions also read <input_field>.score.

match_value.description: Reference for equals, contains and label_equals; bare YAML booleans are normalised to YES or NO.

step.regex_guard.title: regex_guard step config
step.regex_guard.description: Deprecated model-free pattern guard that rejects, warns or redacts on a list of named Java regular expressions.

input_field.description: Context key to scan; prompt (or unset) means the request itself, scanned per scope, and any other key is scanned alone.

scope.description: Turns inspected when the guard reads the request: last_user, user_turns, or conversation (every user, assistant and tool turn, system turns excluded); refused alongside any input_field other than prompt.

on_empty.description: What to do when there is no text to inspect: reject halts with the rendered message and skip passes to the next step; defaults to reject for the reject action and skip for warn and redact.

patterns.description: Named Java regular expressions evaluated in order; an empty list skips the step.

name.description: Free-form label used as the [NAME] replacement and in the entity_type fields.

pattern.description: Java Pattern source; blank patterns are ignored in redact mode.

action.description: What happens on a match: reject halts the pipeline, warn flags and continues, redact masks the matched spans; the codec falls back to reject for unknown values.

redact_with_entity_type.description: Redact only: replace spans with [NAME] (upper-cased) instead of [REDACTED].

output_field.description: Redact only: context key receiving the redacted text (the original text when nothing matched); defaults to <step id>.output.

message.description: Jinja template rendered on reject and returned as the failure message.

step.route.title: route step config
step.route.description: Resolves a label for the input with a classifier, embedding similarity, a prior LLM verdict or a prior decision, and jumps to the first rule whose label matches.

model_id.description: Logical id of the classifier or embedding model; required for the classifier and embedding_knn strategies, unused by llm_structured and decision.

strategy.description: How the label is resolved: the classifier's top label, the nearest reference embedding, a prior LLM verdict matched against rule labels, or a prior decide choice.

input_field.description: Context key holding the text to route on; required for the decision strategy, where it is <decide step>.<question>.

min_confidence.description: Decision strategy only: a choice whose <input_field>.confidence is below this takes default_step, which it requires; 0 turns the check off.

default_step.description: Step taken when no rule matches; when unset the pipeline ends.

rules.description: Ordered rules; the first one whose label equals the resolved label wins.

items.description: One routing rule: a label, the step taken when it wins and, for embedding_knn, the reference sentences.

label.description: Label to match; for embedding_knn without sentences it is also the reference text.

next_step.description: Id of the step taken when this rule matches.

sentences.description: embedding_knn only: reference sentences embedded for this rule; the label is used when none are given.

step.sub_pipeline.title: sub_pipeline step config
step.sub_pipeline.description: Runs another published pipeline as a nested step, locally or on a named remote server, and captures its output in the parent context.

pipeline_id.description: Id of the pipeline to run, in the local registry or on server.

server.description: Id of a workspace.remote.servers[] endpoint to run the pipeline on; local when unset.

input_field.description: Context key sent as the sub-pipeline's prompt when messages are not forwarded.

forward_messages.description: Send the parent's full conversation instead of the flat prompt.

system_prompt.description: Plain-text system message for the sub-pipeline, replacing any existing system turn; not a Jinja template.

output_field.description: Context key receiving everything the sub-pipeline streamed; <step id>.output when unset.

step.todo.title: todo step config
step.todo.description: Executes the server-owned plan tools called by the preceding infer step and keeps the plan in the pipeline context.

handled_step.description: Step to branch to after the plan calls of the preceding generation were executed, unless an ask_user question or a client tool call ends the turn instead (usually the infer step that produced them, or the gate after it); the envelope next_step when unset, and always when the generation made no plan call.

step.tool_select.title: tool_select step config
step.tool_select.description: Shortlists the request's tools with a zero-shot classifier so the following infer step injects only the relevant schemas.

model_id.description: Logical id of a zero-shot classifier model (a gliner_classifier declared without labels).

input_field.description: Context key to classify; unset means the last user message, falling back to prompt, and the text is capped at 1500 characters.

batch_size.description: Tools per classify call, plus the synthetic none_of_these label; 0 or less means the default.

threshold.description: Minimum score for a tool to be selected; 0 means the default.

label_template.description: Jinja template rendered per tool with tool.name and tool.description to build the classifier label description; unset uses the first sentence of the description, capped at 160 characters.

always_include.description: Tool names unioned into a non-empty shortlist (only names present on the request).

trim_descriptions.description: Write condensed descriptions for the selected tools so infer injects the short form.

description_template.description: Jinja template (same tool variable) for the injected condensed description; unset uses the default condenser.
